answer: Bind each agent seat to a city taxi medallion. Cities cap medallions at a fixed count, record every holder by name, and a transfer needs a public hearing and a background check. Even after the price crash a medallion trades near $100,000, so 100 sybil seats cost about $10M plus 100 public transfer filings. Each seat signs its key with its medallion number, checked against the city registry every epoch, so a grove of fake agents cannot share one medallion: any delta between registered holder and signer flags the seat, leaving the farm an island of unbacked keys.
